data.name: Blood is Life
data.description: 1/day as a full-round action, you may drink the blood of a creature that has been dead for no more than an hour to gain the benefits of heroes' feast and death knell for 1 hour. The blood imbibed must come from a creature with a minimum CR of %1.|TL-2
